title: Craftable Iron
description: A simple datapack that adds a crafting recipe for iron ingots. Originally made to skip the grind in skyblock.
body: Craftable Iron, or CI, is a simple datapack that adds a crafting recipe for iron ingots. The idea behind this is to make getting iron in skyblock less of a pain. The recipe is cobblestone in each corner, stone one the top and side middles, and then a lava bucket in the center to get two iron ingots.
